--additional-libs.help: Produce the and linker flags for libraries required by libpcap, but not the flag to link with libpcap itself.

--cflags.help: Produce the compiler flag required to include libpcap's header files.

--help.help: Produce a help message and exit.

--libs.help: Produce the and linker flags required to link with libpcap, including flags for libraries required by libpcap.

--static.help: This option causes and to produce linker flags appropriate for static linking with libpcap.

--static-pcap-only.help: This option causes and to produce linker flags appropriate for static linking with libpcap and dynamic linking with all other libraries, including libraries required by libpcap.
